subject: general
question: A _______ is a computer program that can self-replicate and propagate over the network.
solution:
The correct answer is __**worm**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **worm** is a type of malicious software program whose primary function is to infect other computers while remaining active on infected systems.
 
• Unlike a virus, a worm does not need to attach itself to an existing program. Instead, it can self-replicate and spread independently over a network.
 
• Worms are designed to exploit vulnerabilities in operating systems and can cause significant damage by consuming bandwidth, overloading web servers, and spreading other types of malware.
 
• Examples of famous worms include the Morris Worm, ILOVEYOU, and WannaCry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Macro virus** is a type of virus written in a macro language and embedded within a document or spreadsheet.
 
• **Boot sector virus** infects the master boot record of a storage device, making it difficult to remove.
 
• **Trojan horse** is a type of malware that disguises itself as a legitimate file or software to trick users into installing it.
 
• Unlike worms and viruses, a **trojan horse** does not self-replicate.
